thread:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — slot handoff for Tuesday 09:00 UTC. We need owners for the crosscut deploy (auth, routing, embeddings svc). Also need a smoke runner and rollback owner.
Jordan: Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m with health checks. DB migration (non-blocking) at 09:05.
Liz: I can take auth. PR #448 needs merge and one more review, ETA 08:30 UTC. Will @matt to review.
Pranav: I’ll own routing and the canary config. I’ll set target weights in envoy.
Tammy: Happy to run smoke. What checks do you want?
Jordan: Tammy — quick checklist: health endpoints for auth/routing/embeddings, 10 sample inference requests, 2 long prompts to exercise streaming, error rate <0.5%.
Tammy: Got it. I’ll post results in this thread.
Matt: Reviewing Liz’s PR now. If I can’t finish by 08:30, I’ll ping for a 15m delay.
ci-bot: Build passed for PR #448 — all tests green (unit/integration).
Jordan: PR merge is the gating item for auth. If merge slips >15m we’ll push auth to next slot and continue with routing+embeddings only.
Pranav: One note — embeddings svc has a KV cache change that might affect warmup. I’ll add a pre-warm step in the runbook.
Jordan: Good call. Add a short wait and a single warmup call to each host.
Tammy: Smoke run commands:```bash
# smoke runner
curl -f https://auth.internal/health
curl -f https://routing.internal/health
python tools/infer_check.py --samples 10 --long 2
```
Tammy: I’ll run the above at 09:10 after canary 5% stabilizes.
Matt: Rollback owner: I can own rollback and the revert PR. If we see >1% error spike or latency x2 for 5m, I’ll initiate rollback.
Jordan: Thanks — add a quick checklist to the rollback PR for DB rollback safety (no destructive migrations).
Pranav: Can’t guarantee full KV flush rollback — the feature is safe but will require cache invalidation. I’ll include invalidation commands in the runbook.
Liz: Merge done at 08:22. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Deploy job started — canary group at 5% (routing+embeddings).
Tammy: Canary 5% smoke: all checks green, errors 0.02%, avg latency steady. Posting detailed logs to S3.
Jordan: Proceeding to 25% in 10m. Tammy, please re-run the long prompts then.
Tammy: On it.
Matt: Monitoring dashboards and traces. I’ll stand by to rollback.
Jordan: Thanks everyone — if anything looks off, post here and shout on Pager. Otherwise we’ll finish the ramp and close the slot.
Tammy: 25% smoke done, a couple of 500s from an old shard — Pranav, looks like shard-3 needs a passive restart.
Pranav: I’ll recycle shard-3 now.
Tammy: After recycle, smoke checks back to green. Ready for 100%.
Jordan: Moving to 100%, final smoke in 5. Good work.
Matt: Rollback not needed. Closing loop, will prepare revert branch just in case.
Jordan: Closing slot: noted owners (auth: liz, routing: pranav, embeddings: jordan), smoke: tammy, rollback: matt. Thanks all. :tada:
